title: Finally released demo for my co-op action-RPG on Steam!
author: Environmental-Wear13
selftext:
After 5 years of development, procrastination, close to stopping but trapped by sunken cost fallacy, I'm super happy to share that I finally released a demo (which I honestly could and should have done much sooner). It's been super hard balancing work life, family with 2 kids and being a solo dev working on your first game. I'm super happy that I've been able to use AI for some parts of the development since a year or two back but still keeping my own touch on the game.

As a start, I used AI to get help with some specific systems of the game (copy pasting). Then I moved on to more spec driven development while reviewing every single piece of code and being an architect guiding the AI to correct solutions.

Then I also started using AI for some of the art while still trying to keep my own unique somewhat programmer art.

Only thing I regret is that now a huge AI war has started which makes it hard to talk about the project but I'm still very proud of what I've achieved and I've learned so much on the journey. Can't wait to keep working on feedback (hopefully) and continuing my journey!

Steam - [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5103550/Shadows\_of\_Imalor\_Demo/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5103550/Shadows_of_Imalor_Demo/)

Has anybody else struggled with their marketing on for example reddit or other platforms for that matter because of getting that AI watermark?

comments.author: Left-Excitement3829
comments.body: This looks really cool. Any iOS version forthcoming ?

replies.author: Environmental-Wear13
replies.body: Thank you, it really means a lot to me to hear that. Unfortunately no, not planned at least. Right now I'm focusing on getting it out on Windows, Mac, Linux by Mars next year. But I won't close any doors!
